run_body_bbox_detection: run body bounding box detection using aria camera position heuristics and a pretrained detector model
run_body_pose2d_estimation: run 2D body pose estimation across all exo cameras using detected bounding boxes
run_body_pose3d_estimation: run 3D body pose estimation by triangulating 2D keypoints from multiple exo camera views
run_hand_pose3d_egoexo: run 3D hand pose estimation using both ego and exo cameras with wholebody hand keypoint selection
run_preprocess_pipeline: run the preprocessing pipeline to extract frames from aria and gopro videos and generate dataset metadata
